snippet.title: "Model Debut4" Game introduction video
snippet.description:
“Model Debut4” for Nintendo Switch — Releases on December 11, 2025(JST)!

You nailedthe audition and joined your uncle’s agency—but it’s barely staying afloat.
Determined to rebuild it, you take on all kinds of jobs.

And aheadlies the once-a-yearspecial runway!
Aim to bethe No.1 model everyone admires!

Live yourdream everyone admires!

Official Website: https://www.cs.furyu.jp/modeldebut4/en/
